_source: Research notes Focus 1 and Key question A (LibreNMS edgeswitch.inc.php reads EdgeSwitch-SWITCHING-MIB::agentDynamicDsBindingTable, which yields ifIndex and VLAN directly; edgeswitch.yaml sets ifname: true). The notes give no numeric OID for that table, so fdb.private_oids is empty and a SwitchClient subclass must supply both the OIDs and fdb_decoder(). match is empty on purpose: the notes also show UniFi switches with Q-BRIDGE support (Netdata topology-role-qbridge), so this profile is only used when chosen by name.
